packages.name: langchain
packages.purpose: langchain-core interfaces used in retrieval/: BaseLoader, Document, BaseRetriever, Embeddings and InMemoryVectorStore. Model calls stay in provider adapters.

packages.name: langgraph
packages.purpose: Routing, planner/executor/critic nodes, confirmation pauses, resumed conversations and the one-repair limit.

packages.name: langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite
packages.purpose: Persists graph checkpoints for follow-ups and confirmation pauses. Use a separate checkpoint database and server-authorized thread IDs.

packages.name: fastapi
packages.purpose: Backend routes for sessions, chat, receipt extraction, claim review and travel search. Enforces authorization and input limits.

packages.name: streamlit
packages.purpose: Python UI for policy chat, receipt upload and confirmation, and travel search. Calls FastAPI; keeps provider secrets out of browser responses.

packages.name: pydantic
packages.purpose: Validates request, tool and model-output schemas. Rejects malformed fields; it does not verify policy truth.

packages.name: uvicorn
packages.purpose: Runs the FastAPI service. Start with one worker for the prototype so local state and rate limits have a clear owner.

packages.name: httpx
packages.purpose: HTTP calls to the supplied model and read-only travel APIs through replaceable adapters; explicit timeouts and bounded retries.

packages.name: rank-bm25
packages.purpose: Keyword ranking over policy chunks. Normalize aliases; apply authorization and applicability filters before scoring. No local model is required.

packages.name: qdrant-client
packages.purpose: Not installed. Superseded 2026-11-10 by the LangChain InMemoryVectorStore rebuilt at startup from an SQLite embedding cache (corpus is small); keep as the option for a persistent vector store.

packages.name: pillow
packages.purpose: Decode and validate PNG/JPEG uploads, inspect dimensions and reject invalid image bytes. This library does not perform OCR.

packages.name: python-multipart
packages.purpose: Parses FastAPI image uploads. Enforce file count, size and decoded-image limits in application code.

packages.name: pytest
packages.purpose: Development-only test runner for deterministic tools, adapters, API behavior and the golden evaluation harness.

packages.name: python-dotenv
packages.purpose: Loads local development configuration. Commit .env.example with placeholders; keep .env and secrets out of Git.

packages.name: langsmith
packages.purpose: Shared tracing, performance dashboards, golden dataset experiments and reviewed feedback; export failures do not alter business results.

packages.name: boto3
packages.purpose: AWS-specific S3 receipt storage and Secrets Manager adapters using temporary role credentials; proposed compatibility untested.

packages.name: anthropic
packages.purpose: Official Claude API SDK used by adapters/model.py AnthropicModel (claude-sonnet-5-5 by default). Replaceable through config/settings.toml [model].provider.

packages.name: langchain-text-splitters
packages.purpose: Chunks admin policy uploads: MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter for headings, then RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (1800 chars, 200 overlap, start_index).

packages.name: pypdf
packages.purpose: Text-layer extraction for uploaded PDF policies inside a LangChain BaseLoader (one Document per page). No OCR; encrypted and >200-page PDFs are rejected.

packages.name: docx2txt
packages.purpose: Text extraction for uploaded Word (.docx) policies inside a LangChain BaseLoader.

packages.name: fastembed
packages.purpose: Local CPU ONNX embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384-d) as a user-approved stand-in (Option B, 2026-11-10) until the hosted embedding API arrives; switch with [embeddings].provider = "openai_compatible". Model cache ~200 MB under runtime/models.

sqlite: Bundled engine; record sqlite3.sqlite_version at setup
lockfile: requirements.lock.txt regenerated 2026-11-10 from the tested .venv (pip check clean, 273 tests)

deployment_tools.host_os: Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS x86_64; exact patched AMI/build recorded before provisioning
deployment_tools.base_image: Resolve tag and pin tested digest during M2
deployment_tools.reverse_proxy: NGINX image tag/digest to be selected and pinned during M2
deployment_tools.verification: Release existence checked; joint runtime and host compatibility not tested.
